name: reversible_parameter_and_adam_state_pause

predicted_mechanism_state_change.gain_l2: held at its intervention-start value during the pause
predicted_mechanism_state_change.gain_rate_l2_per_step: zero during the pause, restored afterward
predicted_mechanism_state_change.oscillator_phase: held because parameter, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq and Adam step state are all skipped

stability_effect_rationale: The hook pauses every operative model and Adam state together and then restores the native learning rates, so it delays rather than changes the coupled gain/oscillator law. RNG and data-order state may advance, but the captured training occurrence is full-batch over every training sample; no model or optimizer update reads the ordering state while gradients are None.

state_audit.parameters: frozen because every current parameter gradient is set to None and group lr is zero
state_audit.optimizer_exp_avg: frozen because AdamW skips parameters whose gradient is None
state_audit.optimizer_exp_avg_sq: frozen because AdamW skips parameters whose gradient is None
state_audit.optimizer_step: frozen because AdamW skips parameters whose gradient is None
state_audit.weight_decay: inactive because the skipped parameter receives no AdamW update and lr is zero as a second guard
